notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Gameplay [/ h1]

 Change traces to catch items from line to sphere trace
Items that are not in the frontal direction but around the hand have also been easily handled.
 Improved performance by adjusting post process options.
 Decrease acceleration value in the last event so that the event will proceed even if it is moved slowly.
 Rechargeable pistol bullet recovery rate slightly increased.
[/ list]

 Bug fixes [/ h1]
Fixed a bug that did not trigger an melee attack on firearms immediately after dash.
